rows.human_note: Plain, the reader's problem, no ownership needed

rows.human_note: Plain trust fact, said like a person

rows.judge_reason: “We sent an 8-digit code to {email}” states exactly what happened and where the code went.

rows.judge_reason: “Checkout canceled. Nothing was charged” gives the payment outcome plainly.
rows.human_note: The fact the reader needs, first

rows.text: Full refund within 14 days: write to support from your checkout email.
rows.judge_reason: “Full refund within 14 days” gives the term, and “write to support from your checkout email” gives the required step.
rows.human_note: Literal refund term with the next step

rows.judge_reason: “Weighing other tools?” uses a pitch question instead of naming the comparison.

rows.text: Here’s the note Jordan never saw.
